# Code review

Report only verified, actionable regressions introduced by the changes. Follow
`.github/copilot-instructions.md`.

For each finding, include severity (`P1`–`P4`), the smallest relevant changed
line range, and the impact. Order findings by severity. Omit speculative or
style-only comments.

End with a brief summary. If there are no findings, say so explicitly.
